name: 55082 · Stillwater, MN
findings: ZIP 55082 (Stillwater) has 165 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55082 (Stillwater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
